records.description_rewritten: Kolibki Park is a wooded historic estate in Orłowo, Gdynia, immediately north of Sopot, not inside Gdańsk as the original cruising directory labels it. Gays-Cruising uses the name Kolibki, while a 2012 CruisingGays listing of a Sopot-to-Gdynia roadside woodland near an eagle statue may describe an adjacent area. The two are not proven identical, so this is only a possible cross-source association. The park currently hosts ordinary recreation and seasonal cultural events, not evidence of current cruising.
records.location_identity: Park Kolibki, al. Zwycięstwa 291, Orłowo, Gdynia near Sopot boundary; 2012 different-source wooded roadside/eagle landmark could be outside historic park.
records.access_conditions: Public park with landscaped historic estate, paths and nearby forest. Event zones can be ticketed during e.g. 18–20 Sep2026 Dary Ziemi fair; do not confuse open grounds with event entry or protected property.

records.description_rewritten: Galeria Metropolia is an operating shopping, entertainment and gym complex in Gdańsk-Wrzeszcz. Its original cruising listing names a toilet near the Affidea medical facility. Eight visible comments through 2 April 2026 consist mainly of proposed same-day meetings; they do not describe actual 2026 encounters. An older user message from 5 June 2025 suggests a successful meetup, outside the 12-month window. The June 27 2026 national index also shows a request for company and a sexually explicit intention, not confirmed activity. Retail, healthcare and toilet areas must not be presented as consensual sex spaces.

records.description_rewritten: Starganiec comprises two wooded ponds on the Mikołów–Katowice boundary, restored with boardwalks, beaches, sports areas and solar-powered lighting in 2022–23. A cruising directory calls it a car-meeting spot and has comments from April–June 2025, including an April user describing repeated passing visitors, all before the current cutoff. The smaller bathing pond is officially designated and monitored in summer 2026; open public recreation and child-friendly beach facilities are not designated cruising areas.
records.location_identity: Starganiec ponds, Las Panewnicki, at Mikołów/ Katowice municipal border, reachable from ul. Owsiana in Katowice. Official swimming zone sits in Mikołów municipality with Katowice MOSiR as organiser.
records.access_conditions: Outdoor recreational park and seasonal designated swim beach; Polish water authority lists bathing 1 Jul–30 Aug 2026, staffed zone usually 10–18. Paths public subject to local park rules; swimming beyond lifeguard season different safety level.
